propositions: Two dependabot PRs (setup-uv v10 action pin + uv-lock patches for botocore and json-repair) must be landed as a single Gerrit change because they belong to the shared dependency housekeeping lane.

setup-uv v10.0.0 has a breaking change that disables cache on pull_request_target/workflow_run/release events, but rebar workflows all pass enable-cache: true explicitly so the breaking change does not affect behavior.
botocore 1.43.70 and json-repair 0.63.1 are safe patch bumps admitted by existing pyproject.toml constraints and used only via lazy imports or stable APIs.

The uv.lock file requires regeneration with a recent uv (revision 2→3 format change and httpcore2 marker simplification) but no pyproject.toml edits are needed since all bumps satisfy current constraints.
All 19 setup-uv SHA references across 11 workflow files must update from v9 to v10, with zero v9 SHAs remaining and all workflow YAML remaining valid.

Targeted usage-surface tests (test_structured, test_silent_success, test_llm_capabilities) must pass and make lint/typecheck must exit 0; if any bump fails, drop only that package and land the safe remainder via the STOP rule.
